description: This file defines the FontMetrics class within the PdfSharp.Snippets.Font namespace. The class contains a static method TestFontMetrics which verifies font metrics for various system fonts, including loading font metrics via PdfSharp, GDI+ (optional), and WPF (optional). It performs consistency checks across different font metrics, such as ascent, descent, line spacing, and conversions between design units and pixels.

classes.name: FontMetrics
classes.description: A class providing a method to test font metrics for system fonts and verify their consistency across different font rendering systems.

methods.name: TestFontMetrics
methods.description: Static method that loads fonts, retrieves font metrics via PdfSharp, GDI+ (if available), and WPF (if available), performing various assertions to verify the correctness and consistency of font metrics across different rendering systems.
